answer_1.quote: We propose a baseline network named FLONET - it follows the retrieval augmented generation framework and generates agent response in two steps...

answer_2.quote: We measure the ability to generate responses using two standard metrics: BLEU and perplexity...

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation for the responses generated by FLONET and 3 other variants of FLONET along two dimensions: (i) relevance ... and (ii) grammar ... Both the dimensions are evaluated on a Likert scale (0-4).
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate relevance and grammar on a 0-4 Likert scale.
